question: Should this repository authorize the proposed single-actor workflow to reconcile Cloudflare Access and mint repository-scoped GitHub App tokens under the dormant consumer contract?
rationale: Tests establish structural safeguards, but only maintainers can approve the permanent operator identity and cross-repository credential authority.

options.title: Approve staged authority
options.body: Accept the exact actor, App-token scopes, Cloudflare reconciliation authority, and dormant consumer boundary after removing the changelog edit.

options.title: Narrow authority first
options.body: Require a different approval model or smaller GitHub and Cloudflare permission set before merge.

options.title: Wait for atomic cutover
options.body: Pause this bootstrap until the slot-aware consumer and migration can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve staged authority
recommendation.body: Accept the exact actor, App-token scopes, Cloudflare reconciliation authority, and dormant consumer boundary after removing the changelog edit.
